fusions.name: Between the Bars
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

fusions.name: Nail Down
fusions.desc: Throws a hidden blade that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet, and a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Muffled Step
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Jailhouse Shiv
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
